# Cloud and infrastructure

Applies when the change touches: IaC, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD. Every role loads this pack for the steps it works in, on top of its own playbook. The test commands below are best practices the gate runs: put them in the Spec's `[[tests.commands]]`, so a red one blocks the merge. Name the pack in the Spec's Context; it does not count against a Task's `skills`.

## Standards

| Standard | Edition | Checked | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CIS Benchmarks | current | 2026-09-28 | <https://www.cisecurity.org/cis-benchmarks> |
| The cloud provider's Well-Architected Framework | current, per provider | 2026-09-28 | <https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/framework/the-pillars-of-the-framework.html> |
| Kubernetes Pod Security Standards | current | 2026-09-28 | <https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/pod-security-standards/> |

| SLSA for build pipelines | v1.2, 2025 | 2026-09-28 | <https://slsa.dev/> |
| CIS Kubernetes Benchmark | 2.0.1; managed-service variants (EKS, AKS, GKE) at 2.0.0 | 2026-09-28 | <https://www.cisecurity.org/benchmark/kubernetes> |
| OpenSSF Scorecard | v5.5.0, 2026-04-23; 18 checks | 2026-09-28 | <https://github.com/ossf/scorecard> |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item |
| --- | --- |
| Entry (`aidd next`) | CI/CD files are protected paths (major, the security pool); IaC, containers, and Kubernetes manifests are baseline rules (normal) unless a dimension, a risk rule, or a protected path raises them. |
| Specify | The plan or dry-run output is part of the Acceptance; blast radius and rollback (previous version, previous state) are named. |
| Implement | Least privilege on every identity; no long-lived secret (OIDC); images pinned by digest; actions pinned by commit SHA. |
| Review | The plan matches the Spec: no resource deleted or replaced that the Spec did not name. |
| Ship | Progressive rollout (canary or blue-green) with automatic rollback on the SLO; a drift check after apply. |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IaC scanning | no high finding in the infrastructure code | Checkov, Trivy config, or KICS |
| Policy as code | the plan or manifests pass the policies | OPA with Conftest, or Kyverno |
| Container scanning and SBOM | no high vulnerability in the image; an SBOM exists | Trivy or Grype; Syft |
| Manifest lint | Pod Security Standards and best practices hold | kube-linter or Polaris |
| Plan or dry-run check | no resource is destroyed or replaced that the Spec did not name | a script over `terraform show -json` (or the Pulumi or Kubernetes equivalent) that fails on an unnamed destroy or replace; the plan itself is attached for the Approver |

## Keep it current

A standard marked emerging is a draft, a first edition, or a young practice: apply it only when the change clearly needs it, and say so in the Spec. A standard checked more than a year ago is stale: `aidd eval standards` lists it, and the loop contract's research-first rule applies. When the change needs a standard this pack lacks, look up the authoritative source, record the edition in the Spec's Context, and propose the update to the aidd project's roles registry (`schemas/roles.json` in the aidd repository) as an improvement.
